prompt:
Summarize the following passage in three sentences.

A community garden began on an empty lot between two apartment buildings. At first only a few residents planted vegetables, but within two seasons nearly every plot was claimed, and a waiting list formed. The organisers set up a tool shed, a rota for watering during dry spells, and a shared compost heap. Disputes occasionally arose over shade from taller plants and over who could use the single hose, so the group wrote a short set of rules and posted them on the gate. Neighbours who did not garden said the lot had become one of the few places on the street where people stopped to talk.
